[SWS_CORE_03316] Reverse-find a StringView
⌈
A member function
shall be defined for BasicString that allows reverse-searching for the contents of
a StringView:
size_type rfind(StringView sv, size_type pos = npos) const noexcept;
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
